characterDescription: Matrix terminal navigation — 48px fixed, Share Tech Mono 0.6875rem uppercase 0.15em tracking. Transparent background with dim green bottom border (0.3 → 0.8 on scroll). Logo wrapped in [BRAND] brackets — terminal system identifier. Link hover: full bright green #00ff41 + text-shadow glow 0 0 8px. 0.05s step-start — binary switch, no interpolation. Pure black scrolled background at 0.96 opacity. No backdrop blur.

_twist.description: Replaced magenta neon nav with matrix green phosphor nav. Share Tech Mono 0.6875rem — smaller and more terminal than IBM Plex Mono 0.75rem. Logo uses [BRAND] bracket notation. Hover: text-shadow glow instead of drawn-in underline (matrix glow, not editorial underline). All transitions 0.05s step-start. Border 0.3→0.8 intensity on scroll. Zero backdrop blur — pure black field.
